title: [Linux] Use-after-free of FlTaskRunner on app shutdown: timeout source outlives the task runner
body:
### Steps to reproduce

1. Run a Flutter Linux desktop app that uses the `window_manager` plugin (observed with FluffyChat, Flathub Flatpak `im.fluffychat.Fluffychat`).
2. Use the app normally.
3. Close the main window.

The app crashes with SIGSEGV very often (not every time) during shutdown.


### Expected results

The app exits cleanly.

### Actual results

On exit the following is logged, followed by a segfault:
```
embedder.cc (2603): 'FlutterEngineRemoveView' returned 'kInvalidArguments'. Remove view info was invalid. The implicit view cannot be removed.
```

The crash happens on the main thread while `g_application_run()` is still iterating the main loop: a GLib timeout source fires and its callback in `libflutter_linux_gtk.so` casts its `user_data` to `FlTaskRunner`, but that object has already been finalized.

Note that `user_data` of the timeout source and `type_instance` in the failed cast are the same address (`0x55c78106db20`).

`fl_task_runner_tasks_did_change_locked()` schedules
`g_timeout_add(..., fl_task_runner_on_expired_timeout, self)` without holding a reference to `self`. If the `FlTaskRunner` is disposed/finalized during engine shutdown while this timeout is still pending, the source is not removed and `fl_task_runner_on_expired_timeout()` runs on freed memory (`FL_TASK_RUNNER(data)` → `g_type_check_instance_cast` → SIGSEGV).

Possible fixes: remove `timeout_source_id` in `fl_task_runner_dispose()`, or let the timeout source hold a strong or weak reference to the task runner.

This is the same class of bug as #192873 (idle source in `FlView` firing after the view was destroyed). `window_manager` seems to make the race much more likely by changing how the view is torn down (see leanflutter/window_manager#585). Possibly also related: #164564.

### Logs

<details open><summary>Logs</summary>

<summary>Backtrace (gdb via flatpak-coredumpctl, GNOME 50 SDK + debug symbols)</summary>
```
Signal: 11 (SEGV)

#0  g_type_check_instance_cast (type_instance=0x55c78106db20, iface_type=0x55c7813e8560 [FlTaskRunner]) at ../gobject/gtype.c:3949
#1  0x00007f6fe94f5a7d in ??? () at /app/fluffychat/lib/libflutter_linux_gtk.so
#2  0x00007f6fe8106901 in g_timeout_dispatch (source=0x55c782de0dc0, callback=<optimized out>, user_data=<optimized out>) at ../glib/gmain.c:5324
#3  0x00007f6fe810252b in g_main_dispatch (context=context@entry=0x55c780ee79e0) at ../glib/gmain.c:3591
        dispatch = 0x7f6fe81068e0 <g_timeout_dispatch>
        user_data = 0x55c78106db20
        callback = 0x7f6fe94f5a30
        source = 0x55c782de0dc0
#4  0x00007f6fe8105957 in g_main_context_dispatch_unlocked (context=0x55c780ee79e0) at ../glib/gmain.c:4451
#5  g_main_context_iterate_unlocked (context=context@entry=0x55c780ee79e0, block=block@entry=0, dispatch=dispatch@entry=1, self=<optimized out>) at ../glib/gmain.c:4516
#6  0x00007f6fe81061b3 in g_main_context_iteration (context=context@entry=0x55c780ee79e0, may_block=may_block@entry=0) at ../glib/gmain.c:4582
#7  0x00007f6fe82feaaa in g_application_run (application=0x55c780ee6050 [MyApplication], argc=<optimized out>, argv=<optimized out>) at ../gio/gapplication.c:2773
#8  0x000055c75085d4ae in main ()
```

All other threads are idle (tokio workers from vodozemac, glycin image loader threads).


</details>
